## Navimower Map Card 0.3.4-beta4

This beta completes the Custom Area data path introduced with Navimower integration 0.4.3-beta34.

### Changed
- Custom Area polygons are now read directly from the authenticated Navimower Map API `custom_areas` payload.
- The card no longer depends on Home Assistant Entity Registry/state timing when the new Map API geometry is available.
- Device-scoped Custom Area binary-sensor discovery remains as a compatibility fallback for older Navimower integration builds.

### Compatibility
For the direct Map API path, use Navimower integration **0.4.3-beta34 or newer**. Older integration builds continue to use the binary-sensor fallback.
